name: codebase-design
description: Design and evaluate module interfaces, depth, seams, adapters, locality, and testability. Use when deciding what a module should hide, what callers should know, where dependencies should vary, whether an abstraction earns its cost, or how to make one subsystem easier to test and modify. Use for split/join decisions about pipeline stages, shared knowledge, oversized modules, or representation-driven special cases. Also use when another skill needs consistent deep-module vocabulary.
